classification.basis: D0->D1 within-PR rises for b (11.269 -> 18.607) and c_glob (2.685 -> 5.588), but the local composer c_loc rises only from 2.605 to 3.161 and keeps top1=0.549.  Its D0/D1 leading within directions are nearly orthogonal (top1 cos2=0.0001651; D1 trace in D0 top4=0.076; molecule-weighted top1 cos2=0.0001031), so the small increase is not amplification of the old few directions: the representation re-forms into new but still low-dimensional directions.  The components disagree in the strength of the change; there is no DCC-L seed1 and no supervised RCC checkpoint.
classification.label: MIXED_OR_INCONCLUSIVE
classification.scope: The result is not a statement about what would happen if RCC were trained. It says that within-DCC-L training effects are component-dependent, so the low-rank initialization cannot be treated either as a pure initialization artifact (b, c_glob) or as a persistent property of every DCC-L component (c_loc).
